boss.pileRoar.note: Enormous monster roar, deep wet guttural throat, slow and menacing, close-mic

boss.pileGrowl.note: Deep wet monster growl, short and threatening, close-mic

boss.pileDeath.note: Giant monster's long dying roar, collapsing, fading into a wet gurgle and crackling embers

boss.pileStep.note: Massive heavy footstep on wet soft earth, deep thud with a squelch of rotten pulp

boss.hunter.note: Steady roar of a burning pumpkin tumbling through the air, constant whooshing flames and a low hollow howl, continuous, no pauses

boss.harvestShriek.note: Inhuman raspy shriek, dry torn throat, high and piercing, creature in a cornfield

boss.harvestBreath.note: Slow dry rasping breath of a creature through a burlap sack, rattling exhale, close-mic

boss.harvestRasp.note: Dry rattling hiss of a creature about to strike, straw crackling, close-mic

boss.harvestHurt.note: Short pained screech of a creature, dry and raspy, cut off

boss.harvestDeath.note: Long dying shriek of a creature, raspy, falling apart into crackling straw and snapping wood
